title: Sintel, the Movie: Open Source Goes to Hollywood · 阅读摘记
author: Shashwat Pant (2010-12-01); MoCoCo paraphrase
rights: 原影评版权属于作者/出版方；这里只提供简短改写摘记，不是影评全文，也未将影评视为 CC 授权。
text:
影评摘记：Pant 将照料小龙与最后的毁灭并置，强调这部短片的悲剧性。他尤其肯定角色面部表情的表现力，也讨论了配乐如何随不同情绪变化。以上是评论者的观察与评价，不证明导演的创作意图。

English search notes: Pant stresses the tragic reversal between caring for a dragon and destroying what was protected. He praises facial expression and describes the score as responsive to changing moods. These are a reviewer’s judgments, not proof of directorial intent.
